Hi Anna —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I reviewed Diego's draft and put together a short decision matrix and the initial feasibility notes for a BAA. Summary below, full notes attached.

Decision matrix (short):
- If Medica intends to send PHI into Redwood hosted (shared) API: not recommended without a signed BAA + customer-specific controls; hosted is only allowed with explicit legal review.
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) or Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments: supported for PHI with a BAA; these provide customer-controlled networking and KMS integration.
- Cross-border transfers: SCCs supported for transfers from EU to US when customer requests SCCs; DPA template available.

Key constraints / notes:
- Hosted shared tenancy: data retention and multi-tenant logs are the main points of legal concern; we can offer data retention controls and logging filters but a BAA for hosted shared is rare.
- Audit evidence: SOC 2 Type II summary included; SOC2 report stub attached. Full SOC2 requires an executed NDA for distribution.
- Timeline: we can finalize the SIG and the BAA feasibility note by EOD Friday 2027-06-04. Procurement cutoff (June 10) is feasible if we get the SOC2 stub + SIG and schedule an architecture call this week.

Attachments: BAA_feasibility_notes.pdf, SCCs_transfer_matrix.csv
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleDriveLink (decision matrix + templates)

Happy to jump on the 6/3 call — propose 10:00am PT. Let me know if that works for Robert.

— Priyom Das

Redwood Inference

Assuming we get the SIG final + SOC2 stub and the BAA note, procurement can proceed to draft PO. We still want the 6/3 call at 10:00am PT — Robert, are you available?
